source_role: Brighter ImageGen object batch for reusable matrix-skin overlays; puzzle JSON remains authoritative.

art_direction.lighting: bright soft neutral studio daylight with lifted shadows
art_direction.readability: recognizable silhouettes and upper-mid values at 64-96 px
art_direction.exclusions: no floor patches, square backgrounds, labels, people, or clipped edges

processing.alpha_contract: RGBA 512x512, min alpha 0, max alpha 255, transparent border

bookshelf.prompt_subject: low horizontal warm honey-walnut museum bookshelf

carpet.prompt_subject: flat burgundy rose cream and taupe museum reading-room rug

fountain.prompt_subject: pale-stone circular fountain with blue-green water

shrub.prompt_subject: compact cultivated evergreen shrub with distinct leaf clusters

tree.prompt_subject: potted olive or ficus tree with visible planter, trunk, airy branches and fresh leaf clusters

usage: Matrix-skin board-level overlays only; never changes tile, walkable, region, clues, or solution.
